cleaningEssentialsDetails.overviewText: A 750 mL bottle of FreClean all-purpose cleaner for routine cleaning around the home or workplace. Check the label directions before use.
cleaningEssentialsDetails.packageText: A 750 mL bottle costs $7.99 USD. Ask us to confirm stock and delivery options before ordering.
cleaningEssentialsDetails.surfaceText: Ask FreClean for the current label directions and surface guidance before use. Test an inconspicuous area on delicate or finished surfaces, and avoid use on food-contact surfaces unless the product label specifically permits it.
cleaningEssentialsDetails.orderText: Select a quantity and send the order enquiry. FreClean will confirm the final amount, stock, pickup or delivery, and approved payment instructions. Payment is not taken on this website.
cleaningEssentialsDetails.safetyText: Keep the cleaner out of reach of children and pets. Do not mix it with bleach or other chemicals, avoid eye or skin contact, and wash hands after use. Stop use and seek appropriate help if irritation or accidental exposure occurs.
cleaningEssentialsDetails.storageText: Store the bottle upright in its original container, keep the closure secure, and protect it from extreme heat or direct sunlight. Follow the bottle label for the latest dilution, ventilation, and disposal instructions.

fragrance.imageAlt: FreClean Jasmine Breeze room freshener, 300 mL

fragranceDetails.overviewText: Jasmine Breeze room freshener comes in a 300 mL bottle for living areas and suitable workspaces. Use it as directed on the label.
fragranceDetails.packageText: One 300 mL bottle costs $9.99 USD. Contact us to check current stock, fragrance availability and delivery options.
fragranceDetails.fragranceUseText: Use in a ventilated area and keep the spray directed toward the air or as specified by the product label. Avoid spraying directly onto people, pets, food, finished furniture, fabrics or delicate surfaces unless the label permits it.
fragranceDetails.orderText: Select a quantity and send the order enquiry. FreClean will confirm the final amount, stock, pickup or delivery, and approved payment instructions. Payment is not taken on this website.
fragranceDetails.safetyText: Keep out of reach of children and pets. Do not inhale concentrated mist or spray near open flame. Stop use if fragrance irritates the eyes or skin or triggers breathing discomfort, and seek appropriate help when needed.
fragranceDetails.storageText: Keep the closure secure and store upright in a cool, dry place away from heat, open flame and direct sunlight. Follow all warnings, first-use instructions and disposal directions printed on the bottle.

privacy.collectedDetails: Depending on the form you use, you may provide your name, email address, phone number, service type, property or location details, preferred date and time, payment preference and notes about your request.
privacy.useDetails: FreClean uses this information to respond to enquiries, discuss service scope and availability, coordinate next steps and communicate about a request. A service request is not a confirmed booking until FreClean confirms it directly.
privacy.dataHandling: This website does not collect card numbers, wallet logins or private keys. If the enquiry form is connected to our request endpoint, it sends your details over HTTPS. Otherwise, it opens a prepared email to freclean7@gmail.com. You must send the email yourself.
privacy.retention: FreClean keeps enquiry information only as long as reasonably needed to respond, provide requested services, meet operational needs or comply with applicable obligations. Payment providers and the CeloHT dApp are separate services with their own policies when a customer chooses those routes.
privacy.contactDetails: For privacy questions or a request about your information, contact

terms.metaDescription: FreClean terms for service requests, confirmations, payment routes and product enquiries.
terms.title: Terms | FreClean
terms.intro: Use this site to learn about FreClean's services and products. A request becomes a booking only after FreClean confirms it.
terms.serviceTerms: Service scope, timing, availability and pricing depend on the location and the specific request. Customers should provide accurate contact and property information and tell FreClean about access requirements or relevant limitations.
terms.confirmation: FreClean may confirm, change or decline a request after discussing the scope. A preferred date or form submission does not reserve a slot. Cancellation, rescheduling, access, no-show and refund terms are discussed with the customer before a confirmed service where they apply.
terms.productTerms: The website supports product order enquiries but is not an ecommerce checkout. Product size, exact pricing, availability, pickup or delivery details are confirmed directly before purchase.
terms.paymentTerms: FreClean accepts USDT on BNB Smart Chain (BEP20), TRON (TRC20), Solana, and Celo. CeloHT is a separate payment option. The website does not initiate checkout or confirm payment; use only authorized instructions linked to a confirmed order or booking. Never send USDT through a network other than the one selected. The website does not collect wallet credentials or payment secrets, and a submitted transaction hash does not confirm payment.

complaints.metaDescription: FreClean complaints and dispute resolution process for service issues, product concerns, billing questions, and formal review pathways.
complaints.title: Complaints & Dispute Resolution | FreClean
complaints.intro: Have a concern about a service, product, payment or communication? Contact FreClean and tell us what happened. We will review it and let you know what we can do.
complaints.purposeDetails: We aim to resolve complaints fairly, promptly and in a way that is proportionate to the issue. This page sets out the public process for raising concerns about a product, service, payment, communication, or agreement.
complaints.earlyContact: Where possible, complaints should be raised directly with FreClean as soon as the issue is identified. Early communication helps us review the matter, gather relevant details, and identify a suitable remedy.
complaints.submissionDetails: Customers may raise a complaint by email at
complaints.submissionEvidence: . Please include the relevant date, service or product description, the issue experienced, any supporting photos or documents, and the expected resolution.
complaints.caseEvidence: When a complaint relates to a specific order, quote, service request, or payment, FreClean may ask for the confirmation message, invoice, receipt, or other evidence needed to review the matter fairly.
complaints.reviewDetails: FreClean reviews each complaint based on the information provided, the agreed scope of work or product details, and any record of communication between the parties. A complaint may lead to a clarification, correction, refund review, service remedy, apology, or other practical resolution.
complaints.escalation: Where a matter raises broader or more serious concerns, including product safety, misconduct, or repeated service failure, it may be escalated internally for a more formal review and a documented decision.
complaints.outcomeDetails: We will explain our decision and next steps, including whether we accept the complaint, accept it in part, decline it or refer it to another process. If the issue remains unresolved, you can ask us to review it again or contact the appropriate local authority or consumer-protection office, where applicable.
complaints.records: FreClean keeps records of complaints and resolution decisions to support accountability, consistency, and service improvement over time.
complaints.formalContact: For formal complaint or dispute concerns, email
complaints.framework: for the broader framework governing public information and customer communications.

refund.metaDescription: FreClean refund policy describing review procedures for eligible service and product refund requests.
refund.openGraphDescription: FreClean refund policy for customer review and reimbursement decisions.
refund.title: Refund Policy | FreClean
refund.intro: We review each refund request on its own. Whether a refund is available depends on the service or product, how you paid and the information about the issue.
refund.eligibleDetails: Refunds may be considered for agreed service cancellations, product issues, confirmed disputes, or documented failures to meet the agreed outcome. The final outcome depends on proof, timing, and the terms established directly with FreClean at the time of the request.
refund.thirdParty: Where a third-party provider or the USDT or CeloHT payment route is used, final settlement and timing may be governed by that provider’s terms. FreClean does not claim to control settlement timing for every payment method.
refund.requestDetails: Customers should contact FreClean with the transaction reference, the request or order details, the reason for the refund, and any supporting materials. FreClean may request further information before issuing a refund or alternative remedy.

returns.metaDescription: FreClean returns policy for public service requests, product enquiries, and return review procedures.
returns.openGraphDescription: FreClean returns policy for product and service review decisions.
returns.title: Returns Policy | FreClean
returns.intro: We review return or exchange requests based on the item, the details you provide and any rules that apply to the product or location.
returns.details: Service and product requests are not automatically eligible for a return or exchange. A return request must be reviewed directly and may require proof of purchase, confirmation of product issues, or a service issue discussion.
returns.physicalProducts: For physical products, product condition, packaging, quantity, lot, and relevant product safety information may affect the outcome. For services, scheduling or scope changes are reviewed based on the actual agreement and any direct confirmation exchanged between the customer and FreClean.
returns.requestDetails: with the order, product, service request, and issue details. FreClean may request additional information before deciding on a return, exchange, credit, or other remedy.

shipping.metaDescription: FreClean shipping policy covering delivery expectations, shipping methods, customs, duties, and product movement for public orders and enquiries.
shipping.openGraphDescription: FreClean shipping policy for product movement and delivery expectations.
shipping.title: Shipping Policy | FreClean
shipping.intro: Shipping costs, taxes, duties and delivery times vary by order and route. We will confirm the details with you before shipping.
shipping.customerDetails: Customers should review the product price, shipping method, shipping cost, tax, duties, customs obligations, and product restrictions before finalizing an order. FreClean does not promise a delivery date without direct confirmation.
shipping.availability: Shipping availability depends on destination, product eligibility, customs requirements, and operational capability. Some items may be restricted or unavailable in certain jurisdictions.
shipping.fulfillmentDetails: FreClean may confirm shipment method, tracking, dispatch timing, and final destination details directly with the customer. If a route is unavailable or restricted, FreClean will explain the limitation before completing a purchase or fulfillment action.

aboutCopy.c025: A Haitian business with a practical purpose.
aboutCopy.c026: FreClean was founded in Haiti on April 16, 2025, and is rooted in Léogâne, Ouest. It brings professional cleaning services and consumer products together with an entrepreneurship initiative and community-oriented support.
aboutCopy.c027: FreClean began with a simple idea: people deserve clean, welcoming spaces to live and work. We're building products, partnerships and ways for people to take part in the business alongside our cleaning services.
aboutCopy.c031: Useful care. Practical opportunity. Responsible growth.
aboutCopy.c032: Make practical cleaning and household-care solutions more accessible while creating practical pathways for entrepreneurship, economic participation, and community development.
aboutCopy.c039: One company, connected areas of work.
aboutCopy.c040: Choose an area to explore, then get in touch. We'll discuss the details and confirm arrangements before you book a service, buy a product or start a partnership.
aboutCopy.c043: We hear from people looking for help with homes, apartments, kitchens, workplaces, hotels and guest properties. Deep cleans and special requests are welcome; we'll discuss what's possible for each space.
aboutCopy.c044: Tell us where you are and what you need. We will confirm the price, schedule and service details before making an arrangement.
aboutCopy.c048: The current public range includes an all-purpose cleaner, Jasmine Breeze room freshener, and a FreClean-branded bracelet. FreClean is building practical solutions for everyday cleaning and household care.
aboutCopy.c049: Product stock, sizes, final pricing, and pickup or delivery arrangements are confirmed directly before purchase.
aboutCopy.c053: FreClean welcomes enquiries from offices, hotels, Airbnb operators, property managers, businesses, organizations, and hospitality teams.
aboutCopy.c054: For regular cleaning, product supply or a business partnership, tell us what you're looking for. We'll discuss the details and see if there's a fit.
aboutCopy.c056: Product knowledge can be a starting point.
aboutCopy.c057: Entrepreneurship is a core FreClean pillar. The public affiliate pathway centers on learning about products, responsible promotion, and developing customer relationships.

aboutCopy.c223: FreClean is a Haiti-based cleaning services and consumer-products business connecting professional cleaning, household and fragrance products, entrepreneurship, and community-oriented support.
aboutCopy.c225: FreClean is a Haitian cleaning and consumer-products business founded by Johnny Dubic in Léogâne on April 16, 2025. We offer professional cleaning enquiries for homes and workplaces, alongside household-care, fragrance and branded products. We are also developing entrepreneurship and community-support work, with a focus on ideas rooted in local needs.
aboutCopy.c227: Founded by Johnny Dubic in Léogâne, Haiti, on April 16, 2025, FreClean is a cleaning and consumer-products business. It offers professional cleaning enquiries for homes, workplaces and guest properties, with cleaning, household-care and fragrance products and branded items. The entrepreneurship program helps people learn about FreClean products, promote them responsibly and build customer relationships. A community initiative supports eligible entrepreneurship and practical local activities. FreClean is growing from its Haitian base. We share service areas, product availability, pricing, program requirements and contribution details with our team. Our plans depend on the resources, people and partnerships available as the business grows.
aboutCopy.c229: FreClean began in Léogâne, Haiti, with a focus on cleaning services and products for everyday spaces. Founded by Johnny Dubic on April 16, 2025, the business offers professional cleaning enquiries for homes, workplaces and guest properties, along with cleaning, household-care, fragrance and branded products. FreClean is also building an entrepreneurship program around product knowledge, responsible promotion and customer relationships. Community support is part of that work. Contributions may support eligible business and community activities; the founder handles them manually. They are not investments and are not presented as tax-deductible. FreClean currently operates from its Haitian base and hopes to reach more of the Caribbean as resources and partnerships allow. The team confirms service scope, stock, pricing, program terms and contribution details with customers. Affiliate participation is not a job or investment, and no income or business result is promised.
aboutCopy.c231: Johnny Dubic is the founder of FreClean. He is responsible for the company's strategic development during its current stage. No additional personal or professional biography is currently verified for this press kit.
